channel.title: Mercer Island Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Mercer Island Reporter (mi-reporter.com)

item.title: Revolutionary War reenactors visit students
item.description: Revolutionary War reenactors visited fifth-graders at West Mercer Elementary on March 2 in conjunction with a unit the students are doing on the Revolutionary War. Photo courtesy of the Mercer Island School District

item.title: McHale will host MISF’s annual fundraising Breakfast of Champions
item.description: Actor and comedian Joel McHale, Mercer Island High School Class of 1991, will be the special guest host at the Mercer Island Schools Foundation’s annual fundraising Breakfast of Champions from 7:30-8:30 a.m. on April 28 in the high school gym.

item.title: O’Reilly Auto Parts to pay $5.6M for employee discrimination
item.description: Missouri-based O’Reilly Auto Enterprises will pay $5.6 million for widespread denial of pregnancy and nursing accommodations to Washington workers under a consent decree between the company and the state.

item.title: KMIH student broadcasters win national honors
NYHS senior Gabbay named a U.S. Presidential Scholars candidate
item.description: Northwest Yeshiva High School (NYHS) senior Elizabeth Gabbay is proud and honored to be named one of the 2026 U.S. Presidential Scholars candidates by the U.S. Department of Education.

item.title: Mercer Island School District faces $13.4M sex abuse claim
item.description: School leaders received numerous reports that former high school English teacher Curtis Johnston was “dating” a student but failed to intervene, complaint says.

item.title: Island business owners, residents share their thoughts on light rail
item.description: As Rick Haney strolled along 77th Avenue Southeast on a recent afternoon, the new Mercer Island Light Rail Station sat empty to his left. The facility was looking very lonely and needing a crowd of people to bring it to life.

item.title: Islander sentenced to two years in prison for embezzling $35 million from former company
item.description: Four months after being convicted on four counts of wire fraud, Mercer Island’s Nevin Shetty received a two-year prison sentence on March 5 in U.S. District Court in Seattle.

item.title: MISD selected to receive a State Superintendent’s Award for Educational Excellence
item.description: State Superintendent Chris Reykdal has selected the Mercer Island School District (MISD) along with 24 other school districts to receive the Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction’s inaugural award in educational achievement in the previous school year.

item.title: Mercer Island Senior Resource Fair draws a big crowd
item.description: The city’s Parks and Recreation Division and Youth and Family Services (YFS) Department held the free, third annual Mercer Island Senior Resource Fair on March 7 at the Mercer Island Community and Event Center. It was all about making connections and obtaining information about health and wellness, lifestyle enrichment, personal safety and more.
